title: ghostPay
tagline: At the point of submission, ghostPay operates as a widget or plugin, serving as a payment gateway. It comes with an open-source SDK that allows users to link their web2 applications to web3.
description: At the point of submission, ghostPay operates as a widget or plugin, serving as a payment gateway. It comes with an open-source SDK that allows users to link their web2 applications to web3. Users can pay for their subscriptions using either fiat or cryptocurrency available in their wallets. The plugin has been developed with ZeroKnowledge encryption, making it unique in terms of its tooling features. It also offers a smart/proxy upgradable contract feature, enabling owners to manage and upgrade their subscriptions' order date/time.
how_its_made: The development of ghostPay involve a blend of cutting-edge technologies. The backbone of our application was crafted using Solidity for the creation of smart contracts and Next.js for the frontend interface. MongoDB served as our database solution, providing a scalable and flexible structure for data management. We utilized TailwindCSS for responsive design and Canva for aesthetic design elements. The application was meticulously coded in JavaScript and TypeScript, ensuring efficient performance and maintainability. We integrated zkSync to provide tooling encryption with ZeroKnowledge, reinforcing the security of our application.
